description.value: Nita Lake Lodge is a Michelin Key-awarded luxury resort and spa sitting on the shores of glacier-fed Nita Lake in Whistler's Creekside neighbourhood. Positioned at the intersection of forest paths and mountain bike trails, it offers suite-style rooms with gas fireplaces, an award-winning spa, and complimentary canoes and paddleboards in summer. A complimentary village shuttle connects guests to central Whistler, and four on-site dining venues make it a self-contained basecamp.
